verdict.rationale: Latham publishes the free, publicly accessible Book of Jargon – Emerging Companies glossary. It covers founder-equity and financing terms such as 83(b) elections, vesting and SAFEs. LathamDrive adds lawyer-answered FAQs and resources organized by stage (Formation, Capital Raising, and so on). The FAQ and guide content is only named, not described, and it is unclear whether LathamDrive resources are open without login. missing for 10: evidence of the content and depth of plain-language formation/financing guides and FAQs, confirmation that LathamDrive resources are publicly accessible without registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
